main_issue: Who will cover Agent D's unfinished analysis section for the Thursday pitch while D attends the wake

A-B.evidence: B refused extra work (T6); A accepted it ('I forgot you were covering for Siti') and took on the section herself, telling B to carry on (T13, T18); B: 'Right.' (T19)

A-C.evidence: A asked C to take it on (T10); C declined as too risky (T11); A: 'You're right, it's too risky. Then I'll do it' (T13)

A-D.evidence: A proposed the team cover it (T5) and D offered a walkthrough (T9); A takes the section and D agrees 'Let's do it now' (T13-14), then walks A through the file (T30-31)

B-C.evidence: Both declined extra work (T6, T8), and both carry on with their own sections (T19, T21); they never addressed each other directly

B-D.evidence: B only said 'Right' (T19) and never spoke to D; D's plan with A leaves B on their own section

C-D.evidence: D first offered a walkthrough for someone to take it on (T9); after C said it was too risky, D replied 'She's right. It's too risky.' (T12)
